correctness.rationale: Let T be the equality-matrix translation space in R^(n^3). Independent coordinate permutations preserve T transitively, so the diagonal of the orthogonal projector P_T is constant, and its trace gives ||P_T e_ijk||²=dim(T)/n^3. The Zhang–Zhang full paper provides dimensions (n-1)^3 and n^3-3n+2 and all coordinate facet inequalities. Intrinsic distances from uniform tensors with entries 1/n and 1/n² give the asserted radii. Summing necessary coordinate clearances at ANY candidate center yields matching sharp upper bounds, and equality forces every entry uniform, hence unique incenters. Independent rational projector trace/radius² checks at n=3,4,7 confirm n=3 rL²=3/8, rP²=1/60; universal result is symbolic, not finite-rank extrapolation.
